title: a registered hook with an absolute path that no longer exists fails the hooks check
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). A settings file that registers `'/nonexistent/jitso' hook guard` on PreToolUse (Bash and the orca MCP tools) and SessionEnd, the way an old `--absolute` write or another machine's path would leave it: doctor prints `fail hooks: /nonexistent/jitso does not exist` and exits 3.
